title: Autonomous ECD-based stereochemical investigation of clathriamine A
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate and discriminate stereochemical hypotheses, generate/validate conformer and mirror-image candidates, justify coverage and stopping, and test sensitivity.

paper.title: Clathriamine A, an Antibacterial Dimeric Araiosamine Homologue from a Marine Sponge Clathria (Thalysias) sp.

data.description: Two 54-atom C22H22Br2N8,+2/1 Cartesian candidates (original paper SI S10 conformers 2/3) and measured ECD sign anchors; source provenance is explicit in structure_provenance.json.
Source and hash metadata for the two supplied coordinate candidates; no calculated answer values.

required_deliverables.description: Hypothesis search, validated ECD predictions, comparison and conclusion.
